title: Diagram groups and groups of piecewise linear homeomorphisms of the line with global fixed points
summary: Assume $n \geq 2$ and $\ell = (r_{1}, \ldots, r_{k}) \in [0,1]^{k}$ is an increasing sequence of real numbers. Let $G_{n,\ell}$ denote the group of orientation-preserving piecewise linear homeomorphisms $h$ of $I = [r_{1}, r_{k}]$ such that: (i) $h'(x)$ is a power of $n$ where it is defined; (ii) if $h'(x)$ is undefined, then $x$ is an $n$-adic rational number, (iii) $h$ fixes each entry of $\ell$, and (iv) $h(\mathbb{Z}[1/n] \cap I) = \mathbb{Z}[1/n] \cap I$.
